Execute a SQL query and return the results.

This endpoint allows users to execute SQL queries directly from an HTTP request. The SQL query is sent as plain text in the request body.

<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Accept","in":"header","description":"The format of the response, one of 'application/json' (default), 'text/csv' or 'text/plain'.","required":true,"schema":{"type":"string"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"description":"SQL query to execute","content":{"text/plain":{"schema":{"type":"string"},"example":"SELECT avg(total_amount), avg(tip_amount), count(1), passenger_count FROM my_table GROUP BY passenger_count ORDER BY passenger_count ASC LIMIT 3"}},"required":true}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>
